# Heartbeat

Plug-and-play online communities. Heartbeat provides tools for creating and managing online communities with features for users, channels, events, messages, and more.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/heartbeat/.

## Actions

- **Get Events** (read-only): Retrieve event information from the community.
- **List channels** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of channels in the community.
- **List Groups** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of access groups in the community.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of users in the Heartbeat community.
- **Reactivate User**: Reactivate a previously deleted user by email to allow them to access the community again.
- **Retrieve Group** (read-only): Retrieve a single group by its ID.
- **Retrieve User** (read-only): Retrieve a single user by their ID.
